name: Dollar Industries Limited
summary: Dollar Industries Limited makes and sells knitted hosiery in India, spanning innerwear, casual wear and thermal wear. Its range for men, women and children includes vests, briefs, socks, T-shirts, leggings and track pants, plus safety masks and PPE kits. It also runs a wind and solar power unit, and sells under brands such as BigBoss, J-Class, Force NXT and Champion.
